Apple (AAPL) Holder Wealthtrust Axiom Boosted Holding; As Facebook (FB) Share Value Declined, First Interstate Bank Increased Holding
May 31, 2018 - By Migdalia James
Wealthtrust Axiom Llc increased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 65.7% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Wealthtrust Axiom Llc bought 12,480 shares as the company’s stock rose 5.37% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 31,475 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $5.28 million, up from 18,995 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Wealthtrust Axiom Llc who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $918.49 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.34% or $0.63 during the last trading session, reaching $186.87. About 26.72M shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 22.56% since May 31, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 9.99% the S&P500.
First Interstate Bank increased its stake in Facebook Inc (FB) by 35.94% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. First Interstate Bank bought 11,696 shares as the company’s stock declined 0.01% with the market. The institutional investor held 44,243 shares of the technology company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $7.07 million, up from 32,547 at the end of the previous reported quarter. First Interstate Bank who had been investing in Facebook Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $555.13B market cap company. The stock increased 2.19% or $4.11 during the last trading session, reaching $191.78. About 22.97M shares traded. Facebook, Inc. (NASDAQ:FB) has risen 21.69% since May 31, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 9.12% the S&P500.
Among 55 analysts covering Facebook ( NASDAQ:FB ), 51 have Buy rating, 2 Sell and 2 Hold. Therefore 93% are positive. Facebook had 270 analyst reports since July 21, 2015 according to SRatingsIntel. Barclays Capital maintained it with “Overweight” rating and $140 target in Thursday, November 5 report. The rating was maintained by Credit Suisse with “Outperform” on Thursday, November 5. The firm earned “Buy” rating on Thursday, November 2 by Deutsche Bank. M Partners maintained Facebook, Inc. (NASDAQ:FB) rating on Monday, July 17. M Partners has “Buy” rating and $18000 target. Morgan Stanley maintained the shares of FB in report on Thursday, April 26 with “Overweight” rating. The stock has “Buy” rating by Jefferies on Sunday, April 8. The firm earned “Buy” rating on Thursday, October 8 by Argus Research. The company was upgraded on Thursday, February 1 by Bank of America. The stock of Facebook, Inc. (NASDAQ:FB) has “Outperform” rating given on Monday, April 18 by Credit Suisse. On Monday, January 8 the stock rating was maintained by Bank of America with “Buy”.
First Interstate Bank, which manages about $442.80 million US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Ford Motor Co (NYSE:F) by 471,652 shares to 13,983 shares, valued at $155,000 in 2018Q1, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in Pepsico Inc (NYSE:PEP) by 4,978 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 71,184 shares, and cut its stake in Wells Fargo & Co (NYSE:WFC).
